assertions.subject: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
assertions.quote: prion disease can usually be distinguished from Aβ-associated diseases on clinical grounds and based on characteristic MRI findings

assertions.subject: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
assertions.quote: PIB scans were negative in three small series featuring a range of prion disorders, including sporadic Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease

assertions.subject: Genetic prion disease
assertions.quote: Genetic prion disease can occasionally present insidiously and mimic AD

assertions.subject: DLB
assertions.quote: DLB can present as a rapidly progressive dementia and be mistaken for Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease

assertions.subject: HIV dementia
assertions.quote: cognitively impaired patients with HIV do not show high PIB binding

assertions.subject: NPH
assertions.quote: AD pathology is found in a significant proportion of patients clinically diagnosed with NPH
